key_insight: WebCatalyst improves interactive HTML generation by making reinforcement-learning feedback more faithful to sustained browser interaction, visual quality, and runtime behavior.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a way to optimize generated web artifacts for actual usability and appearance rather than renderability alone.
method: Use a game-level GUI assessor for sustained browser interaction and evaluation.
Apply Visual Anchor to mitigate vision-language-model reward hacking and aesthetic degradation.
Use Action-Trace Credit to ground token-level credit assignment in runtime execution traces.
evidence_signal: Training Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on fewer than 1,000 mostly game requests raised Cookie-Bench Mini Games scores from 68.8 to 75.3 and WebGen-Bench accuracy from 48.8 to 56.9.
watch_item: The game-heavy training and evaluation focus leaves generalization to broader, production-grade web interactions uncertain.
paper_title: Catalyzing Interactive HTML Generation Capabilities via High-Fidelity Reinforcement Learning
